mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, conditions are clear at 63 degrees near City Hall. We expect an overnight low of 56 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are a night owl, you can spot the International Space Station at 3:24 AM; it will rise in the southwest over Mount Horeb and drift toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky. It is currently a Waxing Gibbous moon phase.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects until September 20. Additionally, the City Council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover essential maintenance costs and prevent infrastructure failure, meaning the average household will see an increase of about 26 dollars per quarter.

Tomorrow is a big day for local activities with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking further ahead, Tuesday brings downtown farmer's market fun at Hometown Junction Park alongside various trivia nights at local spots like Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, we want to highlight an incident from Friday, August 15, where a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street.
Today's delicious flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM for you to get your fix.
